description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper class and related factory functions for GStreamer utilities within the Rialto server namespace. It includes functions for creating wrapper instances and performing audio track codec channel switching.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper instances.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class providing GStreamer utility functions, including audio track switching.

methods.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the factory for creating wrapper objects.

methods.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory::createRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.

methods.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper::performAudioTrackCodecChannelSwitch
methods.description: Performs a switch of the audio track codec channel, given various parameters related to playback and audio attributes.
